correctness.rationale: The finite distance language, homogeneity and universality equate injective extensions of the pointwise-named nonempty base with realized complete types. A new point belongs to its nearest-distance slot (j,C): its closest old points form exactly one old level-j ball C. In the ball tree attach to C by a new branch at level j; a group in one slot may share arbitrary internal level-j metric (its level-(j−1) pieces are separate new branches). Across slots a distinguishing old parameter gives unequal distances and forces the larger of those distances, so internally chosen metrics glue without further choices. The labelled set-partition construction gives U_0=1+z and U_(j+1)=exp(U_j−1); labeled allocations to slots give the product. In the partition recurrence the first difference of u_k(m) has degree m−2: two-block partitions give positive leading terms, and three or more blocks are lower degree, with u_k(1)=1. Thus the log coefficients use successive degrees 0 through h−2 evaluated at 0 through h−2 after subtracting c_h=1, proving unique recovery from arities 1 through h−1, including h=2. For the finite collision, write the lower hierarchy as nonsingleton pieces plus ones. If exactly one lower piece has size a≥2, a distinct nesting needs two distinct possible containing upper sizes, at least a and a+1. Through five points this forces a=2 and upper sizes 2,3. With no nonsingleton lower piece there is no freedom; with at least two, the only possibilities through five points are (2,2) with at most one extra singleton or (2,3) alone. In each, upper sizes determine whether the nonsingleton pieces are together and where the possible singleton goes, up to symmetry. This proves the first and unique unordered pair at order five. An independent canonical hierarchy enumeration gave isometry-type counts 1,3,6,14,27 and collision-pair counts 0,0,0,0,1. A separate coefficient recurrence reproduced t_0 through t_6 as 1,7,53,434,3838,36566,374207.
residual_risks: The finite census is only for height three through five base points. Nonempty bases, labeled distinct new coordinates, and a fixed finite distance alphabet are essential to the stated inversion and counting interpretation.

value.rationale: The factorization computes a natural all-arity type invariant without enumerating metric extensions, and finite inversion bounds its information content independently of the base size. The minimal collision separates levelwise size statistics from incidence of the nested balls, showing that even adding all level sizes cannot fix the identified loss.
residual_risks: This is a numerical invariant only, not an equivalence of labeled type spaces or a reconstruction of the base. No larger-size collision classification is given.
